metadata.scope: All printed diagnostic tables visually reviewed. Structured data here cover 280 tested investor balance rows and 198 variation totals. Wave/size and portfolio summaries are in adjacent Markdown; their full OCR candidates are not certified structured data.
metadata.skipped_reason: BASE 2024q2 has no dated prior traits; N=0
metadata.balance_scaling: Common five-wave positive BASE SDs; standardized slopes, not partial correlations
metadata.balance_multiplicity: Holm within five traits per sample/scope/adjust
metadata.variation_definition: Residual SS after FE and controls; top1pct means largest ceil(0.01*N_positive) residual-SS contributions among positive holders, divided by total SS; user score is not exact deletion effect
